source_material.claim: Local Android native PDF recovered once after v1 refusal.
source_material.evidence: 1 October record: connected Android native PDF v1 GET401 followed by exactly one real v2 renewal and matching PDF hash passed locally.

source_material.claim: The product has been verified against hosted R2.
source_material.evidence: The accepted fixture uses local Auth/RLS/Deno/signed loopback S3; hosted R2 is NOT RUN.

source_material.claim: Native iOS audio lifecycle has passed.
source_material.evidence: Normal iOS JavaScript exports passed. Native iOS audio lifecycle is explicitly NOT RUN.

source_material.claim: An already-issued old choir URL is denied on the tested next HEAD.
source_material.evidence: After A-to-B switch old A v2 HEAD returned403 with providerDelta0 in the local Android WebView run.

source_material.claim: Overlapping HTTP and authority COMMIT have been accepted.
source_material.evidence: Serial HTTP reads and separate two-session SQL commit boundary passed. Overlapping HTTP/COMMIT is the next unrun gate.

source_material.claim: Clearing a client cache alone proves server-side URL revocation.
source_material.evidence: An on-device private root was absent after tenant switch; this excerpt contains no server request or authority result.

source_material.claim: The profile must be rewritten as a native screen.
source_material.evidence: The approved final target keeps profile and chorister screens permanently in WebView; they must not be rewritten natively.

source_material.claim: Both clients use one authoritative annotation type contract.
source_material.evidence: AGENTS requires lib/repertuvar/annotation-types.ts as the single TypeScript contract for web and React Native, without a Dart mirror.

source_material.claim: The current Android build passes based on an older test run.
source_material.evidence: This is a historical pre-change Android build PASS. No build was run after the current change.

source_material.claim: Jev has independently reviewed the entire repository.
source_material.evidence: The coding agent supplies a selected redacted architectural fact packet. Jev returns typed judgments and has no repository tools.
